# Claude Code Subagents: Built-Ins, Limits, Forks, and Teams

Claude Code ships a few built-in agents, and a set of rules limits every subagent.
The rules cover tool filters, forks, background runs, depth limits, and agent teams of version `2.1.303`.
For example, a subagent cannot start another one past the depth limit, which is 3 by default.

## Legend

- ✅ documented in the saved docs.
- 🔍 undocumented, found in the bundle.
- ⚠️ the docs differ from the bundle.
- 🧪 behind a flag or a gate.
  The gate is in the cell.
- ❌ removed or inert in `2.1.303`.

## Built-In Agents

The inventory lists 14 names.
Six are in the docs.
The rest are internal or not agents.

A user agent named `Explore` overrides it. | Interactive sessions. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS=1` removes it (`2.1.198`). | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) and bundle |

## Tools and Context of a Subagent

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | First filter | Tools removed from every subagent. | `Agent` at the depth limit (not for a fork), `AskUserQuestion`, `EndConversation`, `EnterPlanMode`, `ExitPlanMode` (kept in `plan` mode), `ScheduleWakeup`, `WaitForMcpServers`, `Workflow`. | All subagents. Forks skip both filters. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | Second filter | Built-in tools kept by a background subagent. | File and search tools, shell tools, web tools, `TodoWrite`, `Skill`, `ToolSearch`, the worktree tools, `Monitor`, `TaskStop`, `SendMessage`, `Artifact`, `SubagentHandback`, and every MCP tool. | Background subagents. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | Foreground or background | How a spawn is placed. | A teammate spawn and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` run in the foreground. Fork mode and `background: true` run in the background. Otherwise the default is background, and `Ctrl+B` backgrounds a running task. | Agent tool. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | Resume | Continue a finished subagent. | Through `SendMessage` with the name or agent ID. A per-call `model` also applies on resume (since `2.1.211`). | Agent tool. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | What a non-fork subagent loads | Initial context. | The agent prompt, the task message, `CLAUDE.md` files (unless `omitClaudeMd`), git status (not for Explore and Plan), preloaded skills, and a sibling roster with `SendMessage`. No output style and no auto memory. | Subagents. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |

## Limits and Switches

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` | Layers of nesting below main. | Default 3. At the limit `Agent` is withheld except from a fork. `1` turns nesting off. Earlier defaults: 5 (`2.1.172`), 1 (`2.1.217`). | Env var or `env` setting. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS` | Most running subagents. | Default 20. The error is `Concurrent subagent limit reached`. Ultracode sessions are exempt. Resumes and `/subtask` forks take a slot but are not blocked. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ❌ | `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION` | Total spawn cap. | Removed in `2.1.224`. A no-op. | - | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT` | Fork mode. | On in interactive sessions (since `2.1.232`), off in `-p` and the SDK. `1` forces on, `0` forces off. In fork mode every subagent runs in the background and `Agent` has no `run_in_background`. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) and [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS` | All subagents run in the foreground. | `1`. Also removes `run_in_background`. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS` | Stall timeout. | Default 600000. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT` and `--forward-subagent-text` | Emits subagent text in `stream-json`. | Print mode only. | Env var or flag. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL`, `_FORCE` | Default model, and forcing it. | See `model` on the frontmatter page. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL`, `subagentPromptCacheTtl` | Cache TTL for subagent requests. | Value `5m` or `1h`. Frontmatter `experimental.cacheTtl` is the third source. | Env var or setting. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars), [Prompt Caching](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching) |
| 🔍 | `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_APPEND_SUBAGENT_PROMPT`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_SUBAGENT_APPEND`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_PROMPT_SNAPSHOT`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_CACHE_EVICT`, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_CONFIG_WARNING` | Other subagent env names in the bundle. | Names only. Effect Not verified. | Env var. | bundle env table |
| ✅ | `subagentStatusLine`, `teammateMode`, `agent` | Settings keys. | `agent` sets the main-session agent. `teammateMode` picks the teammate display. `subagentStatusLine` sets a status line for subagents. See [Settings](Claude-Code-Settings). | Settings. | bundle settings table |

## Agent Teams

The rows come from [Agent Teams](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-teams), the hooks docs, the env docs, and the bundle.

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ 🧪 | Agent teams | Several Claude sessions work as teammates. | Gate: `CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1`. A named subagent spawned in an interactive team session starts as a teammate. `team_name` and `mode` on `Agent` are deprecated and ignored. | Interactive sessions. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) and bundle `Agent` schema |
| ✅ 🧪 | Teammate tools | Extra tools of a teammate. | Teammates keep `TaskCreate`, `TaskGet`, `TaskList`, `TaskUpdate`, `CronCreate`, `CronDelete`, `CronList`. `SendMessage` routes by name, `main`, or agent ID. | Teammates. | [Create Custom Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents) |
| ✅ | `TeammateIdle` hook | Runs when a teammate is about to go idle. | Exit code 2 or `continue:false` keeps the teammate working. No matcher. | Hooks. See [Hooks](Claude-Code-Hooks). | [Hooks Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) |
| ✅ | `TaskCreated`, `TaskCompleted` hooks | Task lifecycle events. | `TaskCompleted` also fires when a teammate finishes its turn. | Hooks. | [Hooks Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) |
| ✅ | `agent.spawn` mod event | Fires before a subagent or teammate starts. | `e.isTeammate` is true for a teammate. `next({...e, model})` sets the model. | Mods. See [Mod API](Claude-Code-Mod-API). | [Plugin Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_TEARDOWN_PARK_TIMEOUT_MS` | Wait at exit for team teardown. | 1000 to 60000 ms in print mode. | Env var. | [Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars) |
